yasmin: Short announce: we merged shrink-decode-padding into canary. Net: p50 -1%, p95 -10%, p99 -24%, token-cost -12% for gpt-small-legacy on web traffic. :tada:

yasmin: Change summary: length-aware padding compaction at packer + per-batch tail-trim that removes deterministic pad tokens when downstream decoder supports variable-length decode. Also dropped an extra dup system message insertion on single-turn flows (-4 tokens avg).

diego: Bench numbers?

yasmin: Replay (1% prod) numbers:
```
baseline: p50 30ms p95 120ms p99 390ms cost=1.00
canary : p50 29ms p95 108ms p99 297ms cost=0.88
```

harper: Any user-facing regressions?

yasmin: Ran 5k prompt eval and quick human spot-check. Two edge cases with strict token-aligned tools; we added an opt-out header x-runtime-pad-safe=false. Streaming disabled for the trim. No accuracy drop detected.

deploy-bot: deploy: shrink-decode-padding/v1 -> canary on pool-gpu-e (2 instances) at 2025-09-10T11:02:03Z

diego: Rollout plan + ops commands?

yasmin: Rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 36h, automatic rollback if p99 increases or eval regressions >1%. Ops commands:
```
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-e --tag shrink-decode-padding/v1 --pct 2
sleep 3600
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-e --tag shrink-decode-padding/v1 --pct 10
```

harper: Upload evals to s3 and add console tile for "pad compaction hit rate".

yasmin: Done: s3://ci-redwood/benchmarks/shrink-decode-padding/v1. Closing thread, will post #eng-notices blurb.
